[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
logfile=/dev/stdout
logfile_maxbytes=0
pidfile=/tmp/supervisord.pid
loglevel=warn

[unix_http_server]
file=/tmp/supervisor.sock
chmod=0700

[supervisorctl]
serverurl=unix:///tmp/supervisor.sock

[rpcinterface:supervisor]
supervisor.rpcinterface_factory = supervisor.rpcinterface:make_main_rpcinterface

[program:api]
command=/usr/local/bin/node /app/server/dist/src/main
directory=/app/server
priority=20
autostart=true
autorestart=true
stopasgroup=true
killasgroup=true
stopwaitsecs=1
startsecs=5
startretries=3
stdout_logfile=/dev/stdout
stdout_logfile_maxbytes=0
stderr_logfile=/dev/stderr
stderr_logfile_maxbytes=0
environment=PORT="3001",DATABASE_URL="%(ENV_DATABASE_URL)s",JWT_SECRET="%(ENV_JWT_SECRET)s",NODE_ENV="production",OIDC_ENABLED="%(ENV_OIDC_ENABLED)s",OIDC_PROVIDER_NAME="%(ENV_OIDC_PROVIDER_NAME)s",OIDC_ISSUER_URL="%(ENV_OIDC_ISSUER_URL)s",OIDC_CLIENT_ID="%(ENV_OIDC_CLIENT_ID)s",OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET="%(ENV_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET)s",DISABLE_INTERNAL_AUTH="%(ENV_DISABLE_INTERNAL_AUTH)s",APP_URL="%(ENV_APP_URL)s"

[program:web]
command=/bin/sh -c "until curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; exec /usr/local/bin/node /app/web/server.js"
directory=/app/web
priority=10
autostart=true
autorestart=true
stopasgroup=true
killasgroup=true
stopwaitsecs=1
startsecs=10
startretries=3
stdout_logfile=/dev/stdout
stdout_logfile_maxbytes=0
stderr_logfile=/dev/stderr
stderr_logfile_maxbytes=0
environment=PORT="3000",HOSTNAME="0.0.0.0",SERVER_URL="http://127.0.0.1:3001",NODE_ENV="production"

<clickhouse>
    <logger>
        <level>warning</level>
        <console>true</console>
    </logger>

    <!-- Skip check for incorrect settings to avoid configuration errors -->
    <skip_check_for_incorrect_settings>1</skip_check_for_incorrect_settings>

    <!-- Explicitly set listen hosts to avoid conflicts -->
    <listen_host>0.0.0.0</listen_host>

    <!-- Configure ports explicitly to avoid conflicts -->
    <tcp_port>9000</tcp_port>
    <http_port>8123</http_port>

    <!-- Disable problematic system tables that are causing corruption -->
    <query_thread_log remove="remove"/>
    <query_log remove="remove"/>
    <text_log remove="remove"/>
    <trace_log remove="remove"/>
    <metric_log remove="remove"/>
    <asynchronous_metric_log remove="remove"/>
    <session_log remove="remove"/>
    <part_log remove="remove"/>
    <latency_log remove="remove"/>

    <!-- Disable OpenTelemetry and other problematic system tables -->
    <opentelemetry_span_log remove="remove"/>
    <processors_profile_log remove="remove"/>
    <error_log remove="remove"/>

    <!-- Set background pool sizes to prevent configuration conflicts -->
    <background_pool_size>25</background_pool_size>
    <background_schedule_pool_size>25</background_schedule_pool_size>

    <!-- Disable merges for system tables to prevent corruption -->
    <merge_tree>
        <max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool>161061273600</max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool>
    </merge_tree>


                    <!-- Disable additional ports that are causing conflicts -->
    <interserver_http_port remove="remove"/>
    <mysql_port remove="remove"/>
    <postgresql_port remove="remove"/>
    <prometheus_port remove="remove"/>
    <port remove="remove"/>
</clickhouse>

<clickhouse>
    <!-- Define users -->
    <users>
        <!-- Leave default user as-is by not specifying any settings for it -->

        <!-- Create a new user named clickhouse -->
        <clickhouse>
            <!-- Password in plain text -->
            <password>clickhouse</password>

            <!-- Allow connections from any IP -->
            <networks>
                <ip>::/0</ip>
            </networks>

            <!-- Assign profile and quota -->
            <profile>default</profile>
            <quota>default</quota>

            <!-- Grant administrative privileges -->
            <access_management>1</access_management>
        </clickhouse>
    </users>

    <!-- User profiles -->
    <profiles>
        <default>
            <log_queries>0</log_queries>
            <log_query_threads>0</log_query_threads>
            <max_memory_usage>8589934592</max_memory_usage>
            <max_memory_usage_for_user>8589934592</max_memory_usage_for_user>
            <max_memory_usage_for_all_queries>8589934592</max_memory_usage_for_all_queries>
            <background_merges_mutations_concurrency_ratio>1</background_merges_mutations_concurrency_ratio>
            <allow_experimental_statistics>0</allow_experimental_statistics>
            <do_not_merge_across_partitions_select_final>1</do_not_merge_across_partitions_select_final>
            <!-- Workaround for ClickHouse #102390: SIGSEGV in ColumnMap::takeOrCalculateStatisticsFrom
                 during MergingSortedAlgorithm when querying ReplacingMergeTree tables with Map columns
                 via ORDER BY ... LIMIT N BY (e.g. Langfuse traces.all). Recommended by upstream maintainer.
                 Fix is in PR #103273; remove this setting once a 26.3.x patch with that fix is released. -->
            <enable_lazy_columns_replication>0</enable_lazy_columns_replication>
        </default>
    </profiles>

    <!-- Quotas -->
    <quotas>
        <default>
        </default>
    </quotas>
</clickhouse>

[ups.cp1500]
  driver = usbhid-ups
  port = auto
  desc = "CyberPower CP1500 AVR UPS"
  vendorid = 0764
  productid = 0501
  serial = ${UPS_SERIAL_0}
[ups.cp1500lcd]
  driver = usbhid-ups
  port = auto
  desc = "CyberPower PR1500LCDRT2U UPS"
  vendorid = 0764
  productid = 0601
  serial = ${UPS_SERIAL_1}

DEADTIME 25
MAXAGE 25
SHUTDOWNCMD "/sbin/shutdown -h +0"
POWERDOWNFLAG /etc/killpower
POLLFREQ 15
POLLFREQALERT 5
HOSTSYNC 15

[monuser]
  password = secret
  upsmon slave
[monmaster]
  password = secret
  upsmon master
